webhooks.detail: Twilio sends webhooks for incoming messages/calls, status callbacks, and runtime events (billing thresholds, errors) via webhook pipelines; Webhooks configuration API exists.

evidence.quote: When events occur in your app, you can also have Twilio send you webhooks.

sandbox.detail: Free test credentials (magic numbers; cover buying numbers, SMS, calls, Lookup; other resources 403; no status callbacks). Free trial account also exists, no credit card (per search summary), verified numbers only.

evidence.quote: Twilio provides test credentials you can use to exercise parts of the REST API without incurring charges.

rate_limits.summary: Per-product limits, no single global one: e.g. voice default 1 call/sec (queued), Proxy 30 RPS/endpoint, Video 80 read/20 write RPS, Flex Interactions 20 RPS; HTTP 429 on excess

evidence.quote: This warning occurs when your account sends too many concurrent requests for the Flex API operation you are calling.
Server-side SDKs make it easy for you to use Twilio's REST APIs, generate TwiML, and perform other common server-side programming tasks.
This repository contains [OpenAPI](https://www.openapis.org/) documents for [Twilio's API](https://docs.twilio.com).
